text_block_list.text:
Although we originally removed the
Kikuka Sho
from her schedule, our
adjustments work out, and
Eishin Flash
can race in it after all.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But she is already looking toward her
next goal.
Kikuka Sho or not, she only
has one objective in
mind—to get good
results.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
